name: antasphere-hackathon
description: The participant and coach skills of the Antasphere Hackathon: join (from zero to your team's app running), check (the opening of every session: the clock, the doctor, the push received, the project description, the pacing), the three decks from the organizers' Slideless templates, each hosted with a share link and registered on the platform: demo (episodes of Playwright screenshots), pitch (the stage) and vote (the elevator pitch the other participants read), and for coaches coach-brief (a team's chat, requests, decks and repository, summarized) and coach-help (answer a help request, post on your word).
